_comment: Its target named the zone under a `type` key -- {"type":"TOP_DECK","controller":"opponent"} -- a fifth spelling. That dict IS accepted as a canonical target (it has `controller`) but carries no `zone`, so it fell through to the ARENA default: a card saying "banish the top card of THEIR DECK" banished from their arena instead. The compiler now reads a zone named that way, and the card says `zone` outright.
